fields.v: Spec-first (extractor's classification in Böckeler's terms; the authors do not use SDD terms). Authors' wording: the visible task contract (spec.md and openapi.yaml) is 'the single source of truth for construction and evaluation'; the task is the 'contract-realization problem'
fields.quote: Each BACKENDFORGE task exposes a visible contract that is the single source of truth for construction and evaluation.
fields.why: The value attributes 'spec-first approach in Böckeler terms' to the authors' wording, but the paper never mentions Böckeler or SDD levels; the classification is the extractor's.
fields.doubt: O valor diz que os autores usam 'spec-first' nos termos de Böckeler, mas o artigo nunca fala de Böckeler nem de níveis SDD. O nível spec-first é classificação tua. Vê a §3.2 na pág. 4 e reescreve a parte das palavras dos autores.
